test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

REMOTE
solution: The correct answer is '**close**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Remote**' is '**Close**'. • **Remote**: far away from where other people live. [(किसी स्‍थान से) बहुत दूर, दूरवर्ती] • *Example: a **remote** island in the Bay of Bengal...* • **Close**: near. (के पास; निकट, समीप) • *Example: to follow **close** behind someone...* **Correct Answer:__** *Close.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Unlikely**: not likely to happen; not expected; not probable. (असंभावित; अप्रत्‍याशित; असंभाव्‍य) • **Secret**: something that is not or must not be known by other people. [गोपनीय बात (जो दूसरों को न पता हो न पता चले), दूसरों से छिपाने योग्‍य बात] • **Unknown**: that somebody does not know; without somebody knowing. [वह बात जो किसी को मालूम न हो, अज्ञात बात; बिना (किसी को) बताए, बिना किसी की जानकारी के] 41:T5d6, The correct answer is **'one who talks boastfully'.**
